answer: The design leans on reciprocity-weighted attestation, split across independent auditors, each submission carries a fresh nonce. The vault holds work receipts rather than names, so the jetty of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short. What survives to the grove is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name.
